exposure: combination of intravenous tranexamic acid and per rectal misoprostol
cohort: Patients undergoing caesarean sections at Bankura Sammilani Medical College and Hospital, with various parities, were included in the study.
finding: The combination of tranexamic acid and 600 micrograms of per rectal misoprostol statistically reduces postpartum bleeding in caesarean section patients from placental delivery to 2 hours postpartum, with no reported complications or adverse effects.
